title: Firsthand Framebuilding School is Hiring
content:
Firsthand Framebuilding, Portland’s new handlearning center for framebuilders, is hiring. If you are interested in joining its small team, they would love to hear from you and have the following positions open…

The Customer Experience & Fulfillment Coordinator is responsible for the day-to-day execution and organization of customer service, order fulfillment, shipping, receiving, inventory, and supply shop operations.

This role plays an important part in the entire customer experience. From helping customers identify and purchase the right products to ensuring their orders are fulfilled accurately and efficiently.

The ideal person for this role is highly organized, detail-oriented, comfortable working with systems, and enjoys helping customers. They should be equally comfortable answering a customer question, packing an order, receiving inventory, and working within Shopify and related systems.

Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours per week
Compensation: $55,000 annually
Benefits: Flexible PTO; tax-free healthcare stipend
Location: Portland, Oregon

The Program Manager is responsible for day-to-day execution of classes and the operational systems that support our educational programming.

This role ensures classes run smoothly, efficiently, and professionally while maintaining materials readiness, supporting instructors, managing purchasing and inventory for the classes.

This is a hands-on, detail-oriented role blending class execution, operational coordination, inventory management, and supply operations.

Schedule: 32 hours per week
Compensation: $60,000 annual salary
Benefits: Flexible PTO; tax-free healthcare stipend
Location: Portland, Oregon

See more at the Firsthand Framebuilding Careers Page.
